name: California Custom Cable
old_description: California Custom Cable in Gardena is your leading provider of exceptional quality wire and cable products that are proven for unmatched performance and long-lasting durability. Whether it is minor cable work or major wiring project, our customized wires and cables are designed to adapt to your unique needs. We take pride in our service excellence and outstanding commitment to our customers. When you need heavy duty wires or lightweight cables, trust us to offer you timely and thorough assistance that saves you time and money.
about:
California Custom Cable operates from Gardena, California, and was founded in 2005. The company is a wire and cable manufacturer with 21 years of experience in the industry.

The company specializes in custom wire and cable manufacturing, producing cables built to exact customer specifications. Its capabilities cover automotive and medical cable production, with an emphasis on using high-quality materials and stringent quality checks. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not disclosed.

California Custom Cable serves clients in the automotive and medical sectors, including hospitals and software companies. Its products are used in homes, businesses, and industrial settings, with a focus on reducing cable costs for customers.

The company distinguishes itself through customized solutions tailored to unique requirements, a commitment to material quality, and rigorous testing processes. It was started to provide tailored wire and cable solutions that adapt to unique needs, though the specific founding motivation is not detailed.
